name: connectivity-check-to-public-dns
note: A connectivity probe to a well-known public DNS resolver ('http://1.1.1.1' Cloudflare; 8.8.8.8 Google is the same class). These are routable public IPs, but their presence is never exfil — packages ping them to detect connectivity or use them as a default DNS server (anthropic's agent SDK, aws-cdk). They are allowlisted so a connectivity check is not read as a hardcoded C2 destination. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
